requires: canonical project ID and approved scope
exact application HEAD and source provenance
bounded attempts, changed files, tokens and rollback where applicable
handoff.completionPolicy: Only trusted canonical gate/evidence service may record PASS; role or prompt output alone is never acceptance.
handoff.failurePolicy: Return to originating bounded work item; no unrestricted retry without new evidence.

repositorySeparation.default: Keep governance, role contracts and workflow definitions in Blueprint OS; keep product domain code, tests and artifact evidence in its product repository.

splitIfAnyVerified.criteria: Standalone service has distinct deployment/release lifecycle and proven interface contract.
splitIfAnyVerified.evidence: documented service boundary, operational owner, rollback and versioned API

splitIfAnyVerified.criteria: Worker needs separate confidential credentials, network/OS privileges or untrusted execution isolation.
splitIfAnyVerified.evidence: threat model and least-privilege trust-boundary review

splitIfAnyVerified.criteria: Measured queue/CPU/memory/load on existing runtime breaches its agreed SLO or causes sustained CI/resource contention.
splitIfAnyVerified.evidence: time-windowed telemetry, budget/SLO and capacity test

beforeSplit: prove one end-to-end scoped execution with independent QA
define API, signed grants, idempotency, retry budget and evidence ownership
